basic.name: Hammerang
basic.description: Throw out a Hammer that returns to Falstad, dealing 80~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies hit by 25% for 2 seconds. Reactive to explode the Hammer, dealing 95~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

basic.name: Lightning Rod
basic.description: Deal 107~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy, and an additional 75~~0.04~~ damage every 0.9 seconds for 4 seconds while close to the target. Deals 100% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

basic.name: Barrel Roll
basic.description: Dashes forward and grants a 171~~0.04~~ point Shield for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Explode
basic.description: Deal 95~~0.04~~ additional damage in a small area around the Hammer.

heroic.name: Mighty Gust
heroic.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Hinterland Blast
heroic.description: After 1 second, deal 475~~0.0475~~ damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

trait.name: Tailwind
trait.description: Gain 15% increased Movement Speed after not taking damage for 5 seconds.

mount.name: Flight
mount.description: Instead of mounting, Falstad can fly a great distance over terrain.

activable.name: Frequent Flyer
activable.description: Activate to gain 25% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds.

level1.name: Gathering Storm
level1.description:
Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, Lose 8 stacks.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage.

Reward: After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

level1.name: Dishonorable Discharge
level1.description:
Quest: Each Lightning Rod strike upon a Hero after the 3rd generates 1 stack. If a Hero dies under its effect, generate 2 stacks.

Reward: After 20 stacks, its damage is increased by 30%.

Reward: After 45 stacks, its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds and its damage is increased by an additional 75%.

Mythic Reward: After 75 stacks, its number of strikes is increased by 2 and the final strike Stuns for 1.25 seconds.

level1.name: Frequent Flyer
level1.description:
Activate Frequent Flyer to gain 25% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds.

Quest: Minion kills grant 1 stack. Hero Takedowns grant 5 stacks.

Reward: After 60 stacks, gain 20 Attack Damage.

Reward: After 150 stacks, gain 50 additional Attack Damage.

Mythic Reward: After 300 stacks, gain 125 additional Attack Damage.

level4.name: Static Shield
level4.description: Lightning Rod strikes grant a Shield equal to 4% of Falstad's maximum Health, up to 28%, for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Updraft
level4.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

level4.name: Hammer Gains
level4.description: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt to the primary target.

level7.name: Secret Weapon
level7.description: Increases Hammerang's range by 30% and Basic Attacks deal 75% bonus damage while Hammerang is in flight.

level7.name: BOOMerang
level7.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

level7.name: Thunderstrikes
level7.description: Lightning Rod deals 25% more damage each subsequent strike.

level10.name: Hinterland Blast
level10.description: After 1 second, deal 475~~0.0475~~ damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

level10.name: Mighty Gust
level10.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level13.name: Charged Up
level13.description: Increases Lightning Rod range by 25%. Hero Takedowns reset Lightning Rod's cooldown.

level13.name: Flow Rider
level13.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

level13.name: Sustained Winds
level13.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health, increased to 2% while Tailwind is active.

level16.name: Crippling Hammer
level16.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

level16.name: Aerie Gusts
level16.description: Reduces the activation time for Tailwind from 5 to 3 seconds, and increases the Movement Speed bonus from 15% to 25%.

level16.name: Afterburner
level16.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

level20.name: Call of the Wildhammer
level20.description: Hinterland Blast has double the range and deals 25% more damage.

level20.name: Wind Tunnel
level20.description: Mighty Gust creates a wind tunnel for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the tunnel will periodically be pushed back.

level20.name: Nexus Frenzy
level20.description: Increases Attack Speed by 20% and Attack Range by 1.1.

level20.name: Epic Mount
level20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Flight by 50 seconds, reduce the cast time before flying to 0.5 seconds, and increase the speed by 50%.
